info.name: E-Retribusi API
info.description: Complete API documentation for E-Retribusi System. Required headers for most routes: X-Client-Secret, X-App-Version. Protected routes also need: Authorization: Bearer {token}

request.description:
Register new user account.

Required:
- name (string, max:255)
- address (string, max:255)
- no_telp (string, max:255)
- master_role_id (integer, exists:master_role)
- email (string, unique, valid email)
- password (string, min:6)
- password_confirmation (string, must match password)

Optional:
- master_opd_id (integer, exists:master_opd)
- nama_instansi (string)

Login and receive JWT access token.

Required:
- email (string)
- password (string)

Response: access_token (save as {{authToken}} variable)
Logout current user and invalidate JWT token.
Get currently authenticated user info.
Refresh JWT token. Returns new access_token.

Send password reset link to email. No X-Client-Secret or X-App-Version required.

Required:
- email (string, must exist in users table)

Reset password using token received by email. No X-Client-Secret or X-App-Version required.

Required:
- token (string, from reset email link)
- email (string)
- password (string, min:6)
- password_confirmation (string, must match password)

Resend email verification link.

Required:
- email (string)
Get current user profile with masterOpd and masterRole relations.

Retrieve profile picture from private storage.

Path param:
- filename (string): value from user.profile_pict field

Update user profile. Uses multipart/form-data. All fields optional.

Optional fields:
- name (string, max:255)
- address (string, max:500)
- no_telp (string, max:20)
- nama_instansi (string, max:255)
- password (string, min:6)
- password_confirmation (string, required if password is set)
- profile_pict (file: jpeg/png/jpg/gif, max:10240KB)

Note: email, master_opd_id, master_role_id cannot be changed.

Add object to cart. Uses multipart/form-data.

Required fields:
- object_opd_id (integer): OPD ID of the object
- object_retribusi_id (integer): retribusi ID of the object
- object_id (integer): object ID to add
- quantity_tpj (integer): quantity in TPJ unit
- quantity_satuan (integer): quantity in satuan unit
- total_amount (numeric): total price
- start_date (date, YYYY-MM-DD): usage start date
- end_date (date, YYYY-MM-DD): usage end date

Optional:
- document_support_link (file): supporting document

formdata.description: Required - OPD ID of the object

Update quantity of a cart item.

total_amount is auto-recalculated as: quantity_tpj * quantity_satuan * harga_objek

- id (integer): CartObject ID

Optional (at least one required):
- quantity_tpj (integer): new TPJ quantity
- quantity_satuan (integer): new satuan quantity

formdata.description: Optional - Set to 1 to auto-generate VA

request.description:
Create a parking transaction.

Required:
- transaksi_objek (array): object_id, quantity, tpj_quantity, satuan_quantity, total_amount, start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), end_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- total_amount (numeric)
- master_status_pembayaran_id (integer)

Optional: npwrd, subject_name, subject_address, nama_instansi, no_telp, transaction_type, transaction_response, document_number

Change transaction status.

Required:
- id (string): transaction reference_no
- status (string): one of:
  - cancelled_by_user -> sets master_status_pembayaran_id to 4
  - cancelled_by_opd -> sets master_status_pembayaran_id to 5
  - active_by_opd -> sets master_status_pembayaran_id to 2

Optional:
- transaction_response (string): reason for cancellation
